production.order: Generate r02 first (the bus must read as a bus and Diego as getting on it at 180 px), then r01 and r03; inspect each at 900/360/250/180 px and in the centered 4:5 crop. Sofia's walking photo is 2.1's p03.

shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, not on signs, screens, clothes, bags, machines or vehicles. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep the person and the thing that carries the meaning inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
shared_prompts.solo: Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.face: The person's face is fully visible in three-quarter view, looking at what they are doing, not at the camera.
shared_prompts.daytime: It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.
shared_prompts.still: A still life with no person and no hands: the object lies alone, large and centered, on a plain light wooden table, photographed from a slightly raised angle with a softly blurred plain wall behind it. Nothing else is on the table.
shared_prompts.near_far: Two matching objects that differ only in color: the near one is in the person's hands close to the camera, large and sharp; the far one is clearly across the room, about four meters away, smaller but easy to see and in focus, alone on its own piece of furniture against a plain wall, and visible just beside the person's shoulder so that it also stays inside the central 55 percent of the photo width. The two colors are strong and unmistakable. There is no third object of that kind anywhere in the photo.

assets.item: I go to the pool by bike. / Ana goes to the pool by bike.
assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Ana. Keep her face, long dark wavy hair, light-olive skin and build exactly. Create a new photograph of her: she rides her bike on a quiet city street on a sunny morning, in her sage-green overshirt over a white top and jeans. The bike is a light-blue city bike with a front basket, and a rolled blue swimming towel sits in the basket. Ana and the whole bike, both wheels included, are large, near the camera and in sharp focus, seen from the side and a little in front; she is clearly riding, both hands on the handlebars and one foot on a pedal. Houses and trees line the street behind her. She wears no helmet visor that hides her face.

reference_file.observed_description: Ana (long dark wavy hair, light-olive skin, sage-green overshirt over a white top, jeans) sits on a light-grey sofa and reads an open hardcover book (A1+ 1.2).

assets.item: I go to the office by bus. / Diego goes to the office by bus.
assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Diego. Keep his face, dark curly hair with a little grey, short full beard, skin tone and build exactly. Create a new photograph of him: he gets on a big city bus at a bus stop in the morning, in his burgundy button shirt, with his dark laptop bag on his shoulder. The front door of the bus is open and Diego has one foot on the bus step and one hand on the yellow handrail. The bus is a long white-and-blue city bus with big windows, seen from the front corner, with no number and no text on it. Diego and the open bus door are large, near the camera and in sharp focus, and it is obvious that he is getting on a bus.

reference_file.observed_description: Diego (dark curly hair with a little grey, short full beard, burgundy button shirt) sits at a wooden kitchen table and bites a red apple (A1+ 1.2).

assets.item: I go to the gym by car. / Luis goes to the gym by car.
assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Luis. Keep his face, short dark curly hair, clean-shaven face, warm medium-brown skin and build exactly. Create a new photograph of him: he drives his car on a city street in the morning, in his navy T-shirt. The car is a small dark-red hatchback; the photo is taken from outside through the open driver's window, from the front corner, so we see Luis in the driver's seat with both hands on the steering wheel and a black sports bag on the passenger seat. The front of the car, the open window and Luis's face are large, near the camera and in sharp focus, and it is obvious that he is driving a car; no number plate is visible.

reference_file.observed_description: Luis (short dark curly hair, clean-shaven, warm medium-brown skin, navy crew-neck T-shirt) drinks coffee from a white mug at a wooden table in his bright kitchen (A1+ 1.2).
